scenario: LEXP.7.19: `==` between whole `Json` values of two facts, as a join. A holds {x:1, y:2}; B b1 holds the same object with its members in the other order and joins; B b2 differs in one leaf and does not. The log is exactly `b1`. PATH PINNED: the join test, not the predicate inside one pattern. `eq_key_decided` (libds `rete/beta.c`) refuses a `Json` key, so the EQ index is not probed: every pair is SCANNED and the EQ evaluated by `val_cmp`. Mercury has no index and answers in `ds.eval` `compare_outcome`.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: String key
    j: Json mutable

schema B scope logical:
    id: String key
    j: Json mutable

rule r:
    A a
    B b where b.j == a.j
->
    log info "{b.id}"
